name: Bonk & Block [5v5]
desc:
💥 BLOW UP THEIR COVER. THEN TAKE THE SHOT.

Bonk & Block is a fast PvP shooter where every wall can be destroyed. Blast away enemy cover with explosives, then finish them with your gun before they find a new spot!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite to get notified when new maps and weapons drop!
🐞 Still in beta — report bugs in our community group.
